record.description_short: Noah and Mio lead a party through the war-torn world of Aionios in a story about life, conflict, and freedom.
record.description_ar: انضم إلى Noah وMio ورفاقهما في رحلة عبر عالم Aionios الذي يعيش حربًا لا تنتهي. غيّر الفئات، وجنّد الـHeroes، واستخدم Ouroboros وChain Attacks، واكشف حقيقة العالم والصراع المستمر.
record.nintendoNotes:
Nintendo Switch base game is active since 2022-07-29. The native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is officially scheduled for 2026-12-03, so it is upcoming as of 2026-08-26 even though the supplier already lists an NS2 option. Nintendo announces 4K TV / full-HD handheld at 60 fps, plus a new Hero and quest, defensive battle mode, and fully voiced event scenes.

Supplier language selection: Simplified Chinese. Four supplier variants per platform mapped by established rule.
NS1: Regular ¥6.8 -> 1,250; Special ¥11.7 -> 2,500; Standard ¥85.2 -> 18,500; Deluxe ¥114.6 -> 25,000 IQD.
NS2: Regular ¥11.7 -> 2,500; Special ¥16.6 -> 3,500; Standard ¥95 -> 20,750; Deluxe ¥124.4 -> 27,250 IQD.
Dual-platform type.cost fields are intentionally blank because the template has no platform-specific price/cost dimension.
record.tagline: Live to fight. Fight to live.
fitFor: Players who prioritize story and character development
Players who enjoy flexible class systems
Fans of large party battles and exploration
Players who enjoy emotional, long-form ensemble stories
notFitFor: Players looking for a short action game
Players who dislike complex party systems
Players who prefer purely turn-based combat

contents.label: New Hero, defensive battle mode, fully voiced event scenes

gameplayPillars.title: Classes and Heroes
gameplayPillars.description: Each core character can learn and switch classes, inherit Master Arts and skills, and combine roles from recruited Heroes.

gameplayPillars.title: Ouroboros
gameplayPillars.description: Ouroboros transformations merge paired characters for temporary powerful forms with unique abilities and progression.

gameplayPillars.title: Large party battles
gameplayPillars.description: The active party is unusually large for the series, emphasizing roles, positioning, combos, aggro management, Interlinking, and Chain Attacks.

record.worldSummary: Aionios is a vast world dominated by the rival nations of Keves and Agnus. Soldiers live under strict lifespans and fight to fill Flame Clocks, while the party travels across colonies, battlefields, wilderness, and ruins seeking the truth.

storyChapters.title: Keves and Agnus
storyChapters.body: Noah and Mio begin as enemies from Keves and Agnus but are forced to cooperate after a life-changing encounter.

storyChapters.title: Noah and Mio
storyChapters.body: The party crosses Aionios, freeing colonies and challenging the systems that sustain the war.

storyChapters.title: The truth of Aionios
storyChapters.body: The journey reveals the forces behind the world’s cycle and ties the story to the broader Xenoblade chronology.

record.perfNotes: Nintendo Switch uses dynamic internal resolution and temporal reconstruction toward 1080p docked / 720p handheld with a 30 fps cap that can dip in complex scenes. The upcoming native Switch 2 Edition is officially announced for 4K TV / 1080p handheld at 60 fps.
record.storageNotes: Switch base game is about 14.4 GB. Nintendo estimates 42.6 GB for the native Switch 2 Edition.

dlc.name: DLC Wave 4 — Future Redeemed
dlc.description: Major story expansion Future Redeemed, plus additional systems and content in the fourth DLC wave.

record.verdictSummary: One of the most highly rated entries in the series, combining an emotional ensemble story with flexible class building and large-scale battles. The Switch 2 Edition is announced but not yet released as of this extraction date.

record.nintendoNotes:
Official platform status: Nintendo Switch version released 2020-05-29. A native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is also available in 2026 with 4K TV output, full-HD handheld output and 60 fps, plus Ether Jet traversal, extra equipment and fully voiced Heart-to-Hearts.

Supplier language selection: Simplified Chinese. Supplier matrix: NS1 Regular ¥11.7 (pre-discount ¥15); NS1 Standard ¥173.4; NS2 Regular ¥21.5; NS2 Standard ¥193. Two supplier variants per platform means no DLC product type.
Converted costs: NS1 Regular 2,500 IQD; NS1 Standard 38,000 IQD; NS2 Regular 4,500 IQD; NS2 Standard 42,250 IQD.
Because the current template has no platform-specific type.cost field, active type.cost values remain blank instead of selecting an incorrect platform cost.

gameplayPillars.title: Vision and tactical reactions
gameplayPillars.description: Shulk’s visions can reveal dangerous future events, allowing the player to respond with Arts, positioning, buffs, or party coordination.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore the titans
gameplayPillars.description: Large regions reward exploration with landmarks, quests, unique monsters, collectibles, and hidden routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Build the party
gameplayPillars.description: Party building combines Arts, equipment, gems, affinity, skill links, and Chain Attacks.

record.worldSummary: The world is formed around the bodies of two colossal titans, Bionis and Mechonis, locked in an ancient conflict. Settlements, wilderness, ruins, and battlefields stretch across their bodies.

storyChapters.title: A world on two titans
storyChapters.body: Life on Bionis is shattered by a renewed Mechon assault, placing Shulk and the Monado at the center of a larger conflict.

storyChapters.title: Shulk and the Monado
storyChapters.body: The journey across Bionis and Mechonis gradually reveals the origins of the Monado, the Mechon, and the world itself.

storyChapters.title: Future Connected
storyChapters.body: Future Connected is an included epilogue set after the main story, adding a new region and a continuation for key characters.

features: Large interconnected areas across Bionis and Mechonis
record.perfNotes: Nintendo Switch targets 30 fps with dynamic resolution around 504p-720p docked and 378p-540p handheld. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition officially runs at 60 fps with 4K TV output and full-HD handheld output.
record.storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.7 GB for the Switch version and 33.8 GB for the native Switch 2 Edition.
record.verdictSummary: A highly rated remaster that preserves the original’s story and combat while substantially improving presentation and usability. The Switch 2 Edition further improves clarity and frame rate.

record.nintendoNotes:
Official platform status: native Nintendo Switch release on 2025-03-20 and native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on 2026-02-19. Switch 2 Edition supports up to 4K / 60 fps in TV mode and up to 1080p / 60 fps handheld. Online squads can include up to 32 players; Nintendo Switch Online is required only for online features.

Supplier language selection supplied by user: Simplified Chinese.
Supplier matrix: NS1 Regular ¥6.8 (pre-discount ¥10); NS1 Standard ¥95; NS2 Regular ¥11.7; NS2 Standard ¥114.6. Two supplier variants per platform means no paid DLC product type is created.
Converted purchase costs at 1 CNY = 220 IQD, rounded down to nearest 250 IQD: NS1 Regular 1,250 IQD; NS1 Standard 20,750 IQD; NS2 Regular 2,500 IQD; NS2 Standard 25,000 IQD.
The template has one cost per product type and no platform-specific cost subfield; therefore dual-platform type.cost fields are intentionally left blank rather than mixing NS1 and NS2 costs.

contents.label: Nintendo Switch game + Switch 2 Upgrade Pack

gameplayPillars.title: Explore Mira
gameplayPillars.description: Exploration is central: the player surveys continents, plants probes, discovers landmarks, gathers materials, and opens new routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Master Arts and Classes
gameplayPillars.description: Real-time party combat uses auto-attacks, Arts, positioning, cooldowns, class progression, equipment, and coordinated party roles.

gameplayPillars.title: Pilot Skells
gameplayPillars.description: Skells add a second layer of movement and battle, allowing faster traversal, flight later in progression, and large-scale combat.

record.worldSummary: Mira is a massive alien planet divided into distinct regions with different climates, ecosystems, creatures, resources, and ruins. New Los Angeles serves as humanity’s base after the White Whale crash.

storyChapters.title: The White Whale and New Los Angeles
storyChapters.body: The White Whale escapes Earth’s destruction but crashes on Mira. Survivors establish New Los Angeles and race to secure humanity’s future.

storyChapters.title: Life on Mira
storyChapters.body: BLADE explores Mira, rescues survivors, studies alien life, and uncovers competing factions and mysteries surrounding the planet.

storyChapters.title: The fight for humanity’s future
storyChapters.body: The story expands beyond the original Wii U release with additional narrative material included in the Definitive Edition.

features: Large seamless regions across planet Mira
Online squads for up to 32 players
record.perfNotes: Nintendo Switch: measured target is 30 fps, with dynamic resolution reaching about 1080p docked and 720p handheld. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition: Nintendo officially advertises up to 4K / 60 fps TV and up to 1080p / 60 fps handheld. Actual rendering resolution can differ from output resolution.
record.storageNotes: Nintendo lists 13.5 GB for Nintendo Switch and 14.8 GB for Nintendo Switch 2 on the current product page.
record.verdictSummary: A critically well-received, unusually large science-fiction RPG whose strongest qualities are exploration, world scale, customization, and Skell gameplay. Its dense systems and long runtime make it best suited to players who enjoy deep RPG progression.

timeline.title: Nintendo Switch release
timeline.body: Definitive Edition launched for Nintendo Switch.

timeline.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition digital release
timeline.body: Native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition launched digitally with enhanced resolution and frame rate.

timeline.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition physical release
timeline.body: Physical Nintendo Switch 2 Edition became available at select retailers.
